# AnantLink

AnantLink is building connected-care infrastructure for hospitals in India. The modular platform is intended to connect patient monitoring, patient and equipment real-time location (RTLS), fall alerts, indoor environment monitoring, and hospital workflows with existing systems. Product examples and hospital walkthroughs on this site are simulations unless explicitly stated otherwise.

## Main pages
- [Home](https://anantlink.com/): Platform overview and connected-care workflow.
- [Solutions](https://anantlink.com/solutions): Hospital monitoring, RTLS, asset tracking, environment, and automation modules.
- [Hospital in Motion](https://anantlink.com/experience): Simulated campus walkthrough and device demonstrations.
- [Product workflows](https://anantlink.com/demo): Sample signal-to-response workflows.
- [About](https://anantlink.com/about): Company and platform architecture.
- [Contact](https://anantlink.com/contact): Contact and pilot enquiry form.
